game_title: Split Join Assembly – Blizzard Saddle Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle, a saddle between peaks: the mountaineer must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Split Join Assembly: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders.
theme: Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle: a saddle between peaks
core_gameplay_loop: In Blizzard Saddle, repeat each round: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders. Each round, a new flares challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the assembly value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 420 points of flares by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 420, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Split Join Assembly
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Split Join Assembly' (Week 8 slot 4), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Blizzard Saddle'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how assembly changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Blizzard Saddle.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 420 within 54 seconds.
